name: Cologne
tagline: A Gothic cathedral and Kölsch on the Rhine
summary: Cologne's twin-spired cathedral is one of the largest Gothic churches in the world and Germany's most visited landmark. Around it are Roman ruins, great museums, Rhine-side beer halls pouring Kölsch, and one of Europe's biggest carnivals.
seasonNote: Spring to autumn is best. Carnival peaks in February with street parties. Christmas markets fill the city in December.
arrival: Cologne Hauptbahnhof is next to the cathedral. Trains come from Frankfurt (1 hour), Amsterdam (2.5 hours) and Brussels (2 hours).
gettingAround: Walk the old town; trams and S-Bahn cover the rest.
cashTip: Cards are now widely accepted, but many bakeries, beer halls and small shops still prefer cash.
foodTip: Kölsch beer in small glasses, Himmel un Ääd, Halve Hahn and Rhine sauerbraten.
buyTip: Eau de Cologne (4711), chocolate and carnival souvenirs.
